# SparkCodeHub

> SparkCodeHub is a comprehensive online tutorial platform specializing in big data processing, distributed computing, and modern web development technologies.

SparkCodeHub offers free, beginner-friendly tutorials covering Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, Java, Scala, SQL, and web frameworks like Angular and React. The platform serves as a central hub for learning data engineering, machine learning, and software development fundamentals.

## Key Topics

- Apache Spark
- PySpark
- Python
- SQL
- Java
- Scala
- Big Data Processing
- Distributed Computing
- Data Engineering
- Machine Learning
- Web Development
- React
- Angular
- Apache Airflow
- Delta Lake

## Big Data & Distributed Computing

- [Apache Spark Tutorial for Beginners: Master Big Data Processing](https://sparkcodehub.com/spark/fundamentals/tutorial): Beginner-friendly Apache Spark tutorial covering setup, architecture, Scala
- [Introduction to PySpark: A Comprehensive Guide for Beginners](https://sparkcodehub.com/pyspark/fundamentals/introduction): Comprehensive PySpark introduction covering fundamentals, architecture, setup
- [Delta Lake Tutorial with Apache Spark in Scala: Build Robust Data Lakes](https://sparkcodehub.com/spark/delta-lake/tutorial): Delta Lake tutorial with Spark in Scala covering ACID, schema enforcement
- [Building a Robust and Scalable Data Warehouse: A Comprehensive Guide](https://sparkcodehub.com/data-warehouse-tutorial): Data Warehouse guide covering architecture, ETL, Star Schema, best practices
- [Understanding Apache Hive: A Comprehensive Guide to Data Warehousing on Hadoop](https://sparkcodehub.com/hive/introduction/what-is-hive): Apache Hive guide covering data warehousing, architecture, HiveQL, Hadoop

## Programming Languages & Fundamentals

- [Mastering Python Basics: A Comprehensive Guide for Beginners](https://sparkcodehub.com/python/core/basics): Python basics tutorial covering syntax, variables, control flow, functions
- [Java Programming Fundamentals: A Comprehensive Guide for Beginners](https://sparkcodehub.com/java/fundamentals/tutorial): Java fundamentals tutorial covering JVM, JDK, OOP, core concepts
- [Mastering Scala Fundamentals: A Comprehensive Guide for Beginners](https://sparkcodehub.com/scala/fundamentals/tutorial): Scala fundamentals guide covering syntax, OOP, functional programming, JVM
- [Introduction to SQL: Your Gateway to Mastering Database Queries](https://sparkcodehub.com/sql/fundamentals/introduction-to-sql): SQL fundamentals covering database queries, relational databases, DDL/DQL

## Data Science & Python Libraries

- [Mastering Pandas: A Comprehensive Guide to Data Analysis with Python](https://sparkcodehub.com/pandas/basics/tutorial-introduction): Pandas data analysis guide covering Series, DataFrames, manipulation, timeseries
- [Mastering NumPy: The Backbone of Scientific Computing in Python](https://sparkcodehub.com/numpy/basics/getting-started-numpy): NumPy guide covering array operations, numerical computing, scientific Python
- [Introduction to TensorFlow: A Comprehensive Guide to the Machine Learning Framework](https://sparkcodehub.com/tensorflow/fundamentals/introduction-to-tensorflow): TensorFlow introduction covering machine learning, Keras, deep learning basics

## Web Development Frameworks

- [Understanding React.js Fundamentals: A Comprehensive Guide for Beginners](https://sparkcodehub.com/reactjs/fundamental/introduction): React.js fundamentals guide covering components, JSX, state, virtual DOM
- [Angular Tutorial for Beginners: Your First Steps to Building Dynamic Web Apps](https://sparkcodehub.com/angular/basics/angular-tutorial): Angular beginner tutorial with setup, components, data binding, routing

## Data Orchestration & Pipelines

- [Airflow Fundamentals: An Introduction](https://sparkcodehub.com/airflow/fundamentals/introduction): Apache Airflow introduction covering workflow orchestration, DAGs, components

## Algorithm & Problem Solving

- [LeetCode 1: Two Sum Solution in Python – A Step-by-Step Guide](https://sparkcodehub.com/leetcode/1/two-sum): LeetCode Two Sum problem solution using Python hash table approach

## Core Pages

- [SparkCodehub for Online Web Tutorials](https://sparkcodehub.com): Main hub for free online tutorials on Spark, Python, Angular, React, Java
- [Spark Code Hub - Website for Online Tech Tutorials](https://sparkcodehub.com/about-us): About SparkCodeHub - mission and overview of tutorial platform
